description: A simple visual to display images based on your data. Perfect for drillthrough pages to showcase a customer logo, product image, or any picture, with support for clickable navigation. The visual comes with the following options: Image scaling Image alignment Supports images from URL Click action to navigate to a website, Google Maps, or any external link Visual capabilities When this visual is used, it: Can access external services or resources Allows users to interact with images through click-through navigation Supports dynamic image rendering based on report data
